name: 1Password
label: 1Password Connect Server API
description: 1Password Connect Server API 1.8.1 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developer.1password.com/docs/connect/api-reference. Operations: list-vaults, get-vault, list-items, get-item, create-item, replace-item, patch-item, delete-item, list-files, get-file, get-file-content, list-activity, listen. Auth secret connect_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). GET/access operations still call the official GET (or access) HTTP method. Retrieved secret material must not be logged and should stay in StudioQuack secret bindings (bind OUTPUT `data` into a secret; do not print it, persist it in engine variables, or leave it on a logged edge). listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put connect_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"list-vaults"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: list-vaults | get-vault | list-items | get-item | create-item | replace-item | patch-item | delete-item | list-files | get-file | get-file-content | list-activity | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'list-vaults'.

schema.label: vaultUuid
schema.description: Connect vault UUID path for vault/item/file ops.

schema.label: itemUuid
schema.description: Item UUID path for get/replace/delete-item and file ops.

schema.label: fileUuid
schema.description: File UUID path for get-file / get-file-content.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: FullItem fields array for create-item / replace-item. values must come from StudioQuack secret bindings. Example: [{"id":"password","type":"CONCEALED","value":"…","purpose":"PASSWORD"}].

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Connect filter query for list-vaults / list-items, e.g. title eq "GitHub".

schema.label: title
schema.description: Item title for create-item / replace-item. Example: GitHub.

schema.label: category
schema.description: Item category for create-item / replace-item. EXACT common: LOGIN | PASSWORD | SECURE_NOTE | CREDIT_CARD | IDENTITY. Example: LOGIN.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Item tags for create-item / replace-item. JSON array of strings. Example: ["work"].

schema.label: urls
schema.description: Item URLs for create-item / replace-item. JSON array of {href, label?}. Example: [{"href":"https://github.com"}].

schema.label: sections
schema.description: Item sections for create-item / replace-item. JSON array of {id, label}.

schema.label: files
schema.description: File parts for create-item / replace-item. Platform file ref-id. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: vault
schema.description: Vault object {id} for create-item / replace-item when not using path vaultUuid. Example: {"id":"…"}.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Query-string parameter `limit` for operation: list-activity.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Query-string parameter `offset` for operation: list-activity.

schema.label: Patch
schema.description: JSON Patch array for patch-item (op/path/value), sent as the whole body. Example: [{"op":"replace","path":"/title","value":"New"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

schema.label: file
schema.description: get-file-content: platform file ref-id for downloaded bytes. Never inline bytes on a logged edge.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: list-vaults, get-vault, list-items, get-item, create-item, replace-item, patch-item, delete-item, list-files, get-file, get-file-content, list-activity, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Connect token
configurationParameters.description: Connect access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. Vault-scoped; customer-deployed Connect only.

configurationParameters.label: Connect host
configurationParameters.description: Connect host without scheme, e.g. connect.internal:8443. TLS only.

configurationParameters.label: inline_content
configurationParameters.description: Connect file JSON inline_content. Keep false so file bytes are not returned in JSON. get-file-content uses the /content endpoint instead.

configurationParameters.label: Patch
configurationParameters.description: JSON Patch array for patch-item (op/path/value), sent as the whole body. Example: [{"op":"replace","path":"/title","value":"New"}].

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
